items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B
items.title_zh: 开源模型 Qwen 3.8 27B 在 DeepSWE 上超越 Opus，可在笔记本运行
items.title_en: Qwen 3.8 27B Open-Source Model Beats Opus on DeepSWE, Runs on Laptops
items.summary: Qwen 3.8 27B is a powerful new open-source model that delivers top-tier performance on benchmarks while running efficiently on laptop-class hardware, sparking significant community excitement and discussion.

items.title: GLM-5.3: Frontier coding with emergent cyber capabilities
items.title_zh: GLM-5.3：Z.ai 前沿编程模型展现涌现网络能力
items.title_en: GLM-5.3: Z.ai's frontier coding model shows emergent cyber capabilities
items.summary: GLM-5.3 is a frontier coding model with emergent cyber capabilities, as demonstrated by community red teaming and vulnerability discovery in real-world software.

items.title: 小红书开源 dots3-note，280B MoE 仅 16B 激活参数
items.title_zh: 小红书开源 dots3-note：280B MoE 仅 16B 激活参数
items.summary: Xiaohongshu's Dots lab open-sources dots3-note preview, a 280B-parameter MoE model with 16B active parameters, 512K context, multimodal support, and a new TEMPO reinforcement learning method for long-horizon agents.

items.title: 🍏 苹果官宣换帅：库克卸任CEO，特努斯接任  苹果宣布管理层交接，现任 CEO 蒂姆·库克将出任董事会执行董事长，硬件工程高级副总裁约翰·特努斯将从 2026
items.title_zh: 苹果官宣换帅：库克转任执行董事长，特努斯接任CEO
items.title_en: Apple Announces CEO Transition: Cook to Executive Chairman, Ternus to Succeed
items.summary: Apple announces CEO succession plan: Tim Cook becomes executive chairman, with John Ternus taking over as CEO in September 2026.

items.title: Google is making private AI practical with homomorphic encryption
items.title_zh: 谷歌用同态加密让隐私AI走向实用
items.title_en: Google Makes Private AI Practical with Homomorphic Encryption
items.summary: Google discusses progress in applying homomorphic encryption to AI, aiming to make privacy-preserving machine learning more practical despite significant computational overhead.

items.title: I compiled Doom's renderer into a 21B-parameter transformer -- no training anywhere [P]
items.title_zh: 将《毁灭战士》渲染器编译成210亿参数Transformer，无需训练
items.title_en: Compiling Doom's Renderer Into a 21B-Parameter Transformer Without Training
items.summary: The author presents a compiler that converts Doom's rendering algorithm into a 21B-parameter transformer checkpoint, which can render frames via token generation without any training.

items.title: A linter for PyTorch 'torch-preflight' [P]
items.title_zh: torch-preflight：用于捕获 PyTorch 浪费 GPU 资源 bug 的新 linter
items.title_en: torch-preflight: A new linter that catches PyTorch GPU-wasting bugs
items.summary: Introduces torch-preflight, a linter that statically analyzes PyTorch code to catch GPU-wasting bugs and estimate VRAM requirements.

items.title: 谷歌被令取消第三方应用商店安装障碍，一周内去除多余警告步骤
items.title_zh: 美国法官勒令谷歌移除第三方应用商店安装障碍
items.title_en: US Judge Orders Google to Remove Third-Party App Store Installation Barriers
items.summary: A US judge ordered Google to remove extra installation steps and warnings for third-party app stores within a week, citing anti-competitive friction in the Epic v. Google antitrust case.

items.title: PostgreSQL 修复高危 to_char 漏洞，攻击者可执行任意代码
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 修复高危 to_char 堆溢出，可致任意代码执行
items.title_en: PostgreSQL Patches High-Risk to_char Heap Overflow Allowing Code Execution
items.summary: PostgreSQL disclosed CVE-2026-14669, a high-severity to_char() heap overflow vulnerability allowing arbitrary code execution, with updates available for all supported versions.

items.title: 苹果自研中国专属 AI 大模型，联手阿里或成首个获批外企
items.title_zh: 苹果联手阿里开发中国专属AI模型，或成外企首例
items.title_en: Apple Develops China-Specific AI Model with Alibaba Support
items.summary: Apple is developing a China-specific AI model with Alibaba's help, potentially becoming the first foreign company approved to offer its own AI model in China.
